_categories.A: interpersonal act: advice, suggestion, offer or request one speaker directs at the other
_categories.B: assessment or compliment about the other person, their work or their decision
_categories.C: emotion or reaction stated about something that happened
_categories.D: incidental concrete detail or one-off anecdote (an object, a place, a small event)
_categories.E: set member dropped because a similar fact was already stored
_categories.F: other or ambiguous: the cited evidence does not clearly carry the gold

_note: Hand-labelled by reading each question's gold answer and its cited evidence turns. One label per question, the dominant one.
